# Satnivik Tech

> Satnivik Tech is a boutique support infrastructure consulting firm for early-stage SaaS startups. We run fixed-scope support audits, set up helpdesks (Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom), design SOPs and escalation paths, and provide fractional support leadership.

## Services

- [Customer Support Audit](https://www.satniviktech.com/support-audit/): A fixed-scope review of your support setup. Delivered in 5 days as a PDF with a gap analysis, quick wins and a 30/60/90-day roadmap.
- [Homepage](https://www.satniviktech.com/): Overview of services, the team, and how an engagement works.
